description: Live, agent-editable chiller knowledge store. Read and updated in real time by the Data Validation Agent (and maintenance jobs) via knowledge_store.py. The 'static_reference' block is a condensed mirror of chiller_knowledge_base.md for fast in-context lookup; edit it only via a deliberate maintenance pass, not per-reading. 'validation_rules', 'chiller_type_registry', 'cluster_registry', and 'learned_patterns' are the parts meant to change at runtime.

sentinel_values.description: Known placeholder/dead values used by BMS/OPC layers. Any reading exactly matching one of these should be treated as a data artifact, not a genuine measurement.
sentinel_values.note: Seed list — refine per data source as real sentinel behavior is confirmed during preprocessing. Use add_learned_pattern() to record new sentinel discoveries, then promote_pattern() once confirmed.

physical_bounds.description: Hard physical/absolute bounds per parameter category (Layer 1). Empty template — populate per parameter type as chillers are onboarded, since physical limits depend on refrigerant, capacity, and design.

temperature_c.note: e.g. CHW loop typically 1-30C without glycol; set per fleet

pressure_bar.note: bounded by refrigerant P-T chart; set per refrigerant type

artifact_patterns.description: Confirmed, stable artifact-detection rules. Entries here have been promoted from learned_patterns after being validated. This starts with the generic rule types from the domain design (see chiller_knowledge_base.md Section 2.4) as seed entries — no fleet-specific findings yet.

patterns.description: Value moves consistently in one direction over a sustained run of samples and eventually exceeds the physical bound for its parameter type, then drops back into physical range in one step.
patterns.rule: Flag the entire ramp window as ONE fault event (not one alert per sample). Treat the single-step drop back into physical range as the recovery point, not a new anomaly.

patterns.description: Value hits an exact round-number ceiling (e.g. 9999, 10000) and stops.
patterns.rule: Check against validation_rules.sentinel_values before any statistical check. Exact match = artifact, regardless of statistical plausibility.

chiller_inventory.description: Live inventory of every chiller the agent has encountered, keyed by machine_id. This is the equivalent of the old Excel 'Chiller Inventory' + 'Tracked Parameters' sheets, but populated and updated in real time as the agent processes new data. Each entry accumulates: identifying metadata (name, model, manufacturer, location, capacity), the agent's type/industry inference, and a per-parameter record (meaning, unit, observed range, sanity status) that grows as new parameters are seen for that chiller.
